title: Ashbury Rewards Programme Terms: One Account per Person
content:
**Clause 1 — One account.** A person holds at most one Ashbury Rewards account; the limit is 1 account per person. A guest profile is enrolled only if it has no membership whose status is active or suspended. A guest who already has an account and enrols again by mistake keeps the original account; the duplicate is not opened.

**Clause 2 — Closed accounts.** A closed account is never reopened, but the person may enrol again with a new member number, starting from the base tier with no points, nights or awards carried over.

The authority for this clause is the membership record held against the guest profile, read before the enrolment is made: the status of every Ashbury Rewards membership attached to that profile decides it, not what the guest says about earlier accounts.

## The clause by membership status

| Memberships already on the guest profile | One-account clause satisfied | Effect |
|---|---|---|
| A membership whose status is active | No | The original account is kept; no duplicate is opened |
| A membership whose status is suspended | No | No new account is opened |
| Only memberships whose status is closed | Yes | A new member number may be issued at the base tier, with no points, nights or awards carried over from the closed account |

## Cases (hypothetical guests)

- A guest whose profile carries an active Ashbury Rewards membership asks to enrol again. The profile already has an open account, so the original account stands and no second account is opened.
- A guest whose earlier membership was closed enrols again. The closed account is not reopened; the new account carries a new member number, starts at Ashbury Rewards Member, and holds none of the points, nights or awards of the closed account.
